Installed reservation precedes the first application script/import/extension/callback read, including local CLI entry. An unregistered old interpreter must reject or discard itself through the installed launcher, never retroactively acquire current authority for buffered old code. Application primitives independently validate actual target operands. Disjoint claims and a fixed verified bundle survive a missing root; bounded installed diagnosis writes no application, authority or service state.

stage_map.status: required before broad stage 3; not implemented or qualified
stage_map.oracle: One real runtime/backend combination acknowledges in-process before any ordinary startup/import/action; disabled callback never falls back to metadata. No runtime/backend is selected as supported by Stage 1.

Immutable target/source/resource intent is separate from the fence-time observed consumer/task/correlation population. Fence publication and population snapshot share admission; durable pre-fence registrations survive death during snapshot; specifically derived finite drain-control helpers can answer only captured existing tasks and record terminal outcomes, not start new work. Every admitted owner needs its own actual-operand behavior test, plus unchanged legacy tests on each batch.

Two genuine versioned workers retain separate queues and incarnations. No-enrollment cleanup remains unchanged; mixed-account unknown/foreign ownership is not swept. Future real named runner must requalify its entire descendant tree against the old parser; the Stage-1 candidate is not that proof.

stage_map.status: not implemented; bootstrap bundle switching explicitly deferred
stage_map.oracle: An operation-owned reactivation substate retires positively dead incarnations, preserves released effects, proves replacements and obtains fresh publication/release authority; unknown liveness never relaunches. One atomic authoritative gate snapshot contains the receipt or a preinstalled verified immutable receipt digest and exact released incarnations; abort reopening uses the same representation. Registry CAS compares only the selected row under the existing whole-file lock. Application operations cannot replace loader/bundle; incompatible targets refuse before mutation. Process-crash recovery only, not transactional power-loss Git/service durability.

stage_map.oracle: Only complete owner coverage, stages 2-5 and a positively qualified adapter permit producer enablement. Real macOS isolated service/backend qualification needs separate authorization. Relocation, conversion, rollback/reset and retirement remain out of scope.
